question: What is the meaning of end-of life guide in relation to guide and instructions?
description: An end-of-life guide is a document that provides information on how to properly dispose of a product at the end of its life cycle. This includes instructions on sorting, collecting, and treating the product to minimize environmental impact and maximize material recovery. The end-of-life guide is an essential component of a product's life cycle documentation, as it ensures that the product is handled responsibly and sustainably at the end of its life.
